title: qabr-e-asghar pa jo shabbir ko rona aaya
body:
qabr-e-asghar pa jo shabbir ko rona aaya
us ghadi madar-e-besheer ko rona aaya
1. baad mere jo layin khodeinge qabr-e-asghar
sonch ke hazrat-e-shabbir ko rona aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ali asghar ki shahadat jo raqam ki haq ne
lohey mehfooz ki tehreer ko rona ayya
<<DIVIDER>>
3. shey no khodi jo lahad roke toh boli shamsheer
mujhko mazloomiye be sheer pa rona aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4. sab toh sab roye magar haye yeh kaisa rona
sansanate huwe khud teer ko rona aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. khat padha shah ne sughra ka jo rote rote
khat-e-sughra ki bhi tehreer ko rona aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
6. dekha sar naize pa abid ne johin asghar ka
istarha roye ke zanjeer ko rona aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
7. dhondti phirti hai har simth ali asgar ko
jab suna margaye humsheer ko rona aaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. nouha asghar ka padha roke raza ne jisdam
hashmi madar-e-shabir ko rona aaya …
